BCIT · API integration

Weather App

Mapped a location query to weather data and implemented current conditions, forecasts and failed-request handling.

My role
Front-end and API implementation
Period
2024
Project stage
Course project

Data requirement

Users needed current conditions and a five-day forecast for their location. The interface had to translate the location query into a request and map the response to readable weather data.

Integration and failure states

I integrated OpenWeatherMap in Next.js and TypeScript using Fetch and Axios, and implemented how the application handles failed requests.
